Terms of Use

By using Pawprint, you agree to these Terms. Use the app with care for cats, people, and privacy.

1. Who can use Pawprint

You must be at least 13 years old. If you are under 18, a parent or legal guardian must agree to these Terms and the Privacy Policy for you. You must provide accurate account details and keep your sign-in credentials secure.

2. Be kind to cats and people

  • Do not chase, grab, touch, corner, feed, or use flash on a cat in a way that could cause harm.
  • Do not enter private property or reveal a private home, gate, address, or exact location.
  • Do not photograph or upload people, faces, or licence plates without permission.
  • Do not use Pawprint to track a person or cat in real time, or to harm, steal, or sell an animal.
  • Do not post false sightings, fake photos, spam, or content you do not have the right to share.
  • Do not scrape, reverse-engineer, overload, or try to discover exact locations behind public pins.

3. Care Flags and rescue requests

Care Flags are community observations, not medical or veterinary diagnoses. In an emergency, contact a licensed veterinarian, local animal-welfare group, or barangay. Pawprint does not promise that another person will respond.

4. Your content

You keep ownership of photos and notes you submit. You grant Pawprint a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free licence to store, process, resize, and display that content inside the app, including in approximate and delayed form, for as long as it is published. You confirm that you own the content or have the right to share it and that it is lawful.

5. Moderation

We may remove content, hide a pin, limit features, or suspend or end an account that breaks these Terms or puts cats or people at risk. You can report content in the app or by email. We may retain safety and report records when needed for legal or security reasons.

6. Streaks, XP, and rewards

Streaks, XP, medals, and rarity are for fun and have no cash value. We may change, reset, or retire them to keep the game fair and safe. Care and safety tools are intended to stay free.

7. The service

Pawprint is provided as is and as available. We try to keep it running and accurate, but cannot promise uninterrupted service, error-free operation, or perfect AI cat validation. Features may change during early access.

8. Limits of liability

To the extent allowed by law, Pawprint and its owner are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, for content posted by other users, or for harm resulting from meeting an animal or entering a place while using the app. Nothing here limits liability that cannot be limited under Philippine law.

9. Account deletion

You can delete your account from Profile at any time. Deletion removes your Journal, photos, and exact capture points within 30 days. Terms that should continue by their nature, including content licences for already-published pins until expiry, liability, and governing law, survive deletion.

10. Governing law

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of the Philippines. Disputes will be brought to the proper courts of Muntinlupa City, unless the law gives you a right to a different venue.

11. Changes and contact

For material changes, we will notify you in the app or on this page before they take effect. Questions can be sent to hello.pawprint.app@gmail.com.
